headline: Côte d'Ivoire: Vincent Bocquillon appointed managing director of SOGB
summary: Socfin subsidiary SOGB, a major Ivorian agro-industrial company, appointed Vincent Bocquillon as managing director effective 30 October 2026, succeeding Jean-Christophe Dienst, who is retiring.
why: SOGB is a rubber producer in Côte d'Ivoire and part of the Socfin group, a plantation-agriculture business with a large regional footprint.
original_headline: Côte d’Ivoire : Vincent Bocquillon nommé directeur général de la SOGB
